ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 75% of the visible surface area, with high-contrast low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the perimeter, central notch, and in linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central interior of both lobes. Dark, high-contrast pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and converges at the median notch. Numerous dark, non-contiguous linear and mottled clusters are distributed across the white fields of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a shallow depth relative to lobe width; interior angle estimated at approximately 120-130 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels along the entire upper continuous boundary; serrations are most pronounced and jagged at the lateral distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge, transitioning into a slight upward sweep toward the pointed, darkened lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered dark punctate clusters (mottling) visible on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe and lower-right quadrant of the right lobe, contrasting against the white pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel dark diagonal lines on the left lobe; multiple intersecting linear marks on the right lobe, including a long diagonal streak extending from the notch toward the upper-right edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear abrasions) on both lobes; highly irregular, jagged trailing edge suggestive of multiple minor tissue-loss events.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, dark semi-circular or 'hook-shaped' mark located in the lower-central region of the right lobe's white pigmentation field.
